description: Realistic tutoring flow for learning arrays vs linked lists

steps.prompt: I'm a beginner learning data structures. Explain arrays versus linked lists with simple intuition and when each one is better.
Use the canvas like a whiteboard and draw a simple linked list with head and tail labels.
Generate a labeled diagram comparing an array and a linked list.
Create flashcards to help me remember the tradeoffs between arrays and linked lists.
Generate a 4-question quiz on array versus linked list tradeoffs.
Before I start the quiz, look at the current quiz and tell me one mistake students make when choosing between arrays and linked lists.
